description: Call ANY Brevo API v3 endpoint directly on the tenant's Brevo connection (covers the full API: contacts, lists, folders, attributes, segments, email/SMS/WhatsApp campaigns, templates, transactional email/SMS/WhatsApp, senders, domains, webhooks, CRM companies/deals/tasks/notes/files, events, e-commerce, coupons, loyalty, inbound, accounts …). Required: method (GET|POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE), path (with leading slash, e.g. '/contacts/lists', '/emailCampaigns/12/sendTest'). Optional: body (object), query (object → query string). Use the named brevo tools for common tasks. Secrets stay server-side. A POST to a send endpoint SENDS to outside recipients immediately — confirm recipients and content with the human first.

body.description: JSON request body sent to the API

method.description: HTTP method: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE

path.description: API path with leading slash, e.g. /contacts/lists

name: brevo_request
